title: Normalized native direct comparison at finite evaluation
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and a scheme morphism f:X→Y. Let d be any normalized Direct model and ed any DirectEvaluation for d [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Construct integralNativeOrdinaryDirectIso by identity on sections between the ordinary sequence direct image and VaryingRing.push; construct integralNativePullIso by ordinary left-adjoint uniqueness followed by exact localization, and integralNativeDirectIso by right-adjoint conjugation. For every system M and finite level n, evaluation of this specified direct-image isomorphism followed by native evalP and the right-derived constant-module change compactSupportDirectModel [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation] equals ed.evaluation at M,n. No compactification, integral input, chosen reduction tower, boundedness, or constructibility hypothesis occurs.

source.place: Coefficient comparisons preserve evaluation and adjunction units/counits; primitive whole-system operation comparison in Step 1 of lem-sf-integral-support-strict-tower-comparison. Stacks 03DI, 0941, 0D6E; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10.

proof.text: Keep the three existing comparison definitions. Their ordinary ring maps agree by the sequence ring normalization. Evaluation of integralNativeOrdinaryDirectIso followed by the native ordinary direct evaluation is the specified sequence direct evaluation: both are identity on section carriers, using the ordinary native section formula and the sequence evaluation normalization.

Apply the proved exact native comparison helper to this ordinary direct section square. It transposes the ordinary square by adjoint uniqueness, localizes the resulting exact inverse-image square, and identifies the localized sequence comparison using its full cochain normalization. This gives the derived pullback square for integralNativePullIso on every system.

The counit equation of DirectEvaluation identifies ed.evaluation with the mate of pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation.inv. Transport mates through integralNativePullIso and the localized nativeFinitePullIso. The finite derived conjugate calculation identifies the latter conjugate with the inverse right-derived compactSupportDirectModel. Postcompose with that coordinate change and cancel the isomorphism. The result is the required equality, on all systems including the zero system and n=0.

theorem integralNativeDirectComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (d : Direct l E f) (ed : DirectEvaluation l E d) :
    ∀ (M : System l E X) (n : ℕ),
      letI := proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage_additive f
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
      (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).map
          ((integralNativeDirectIso l E f d).hom.app M) ≫
          (ProEtale.VaryingRing.evalP (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
            (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f n ≪≫
            Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorNatIso
              (compactSupportDirectModel f
                (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))).hom.app M =
        (ed.evaluation n).hom.app M
